subject: SDK shim sync: timelines, exceptions, and comms path
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SDK shim sync: timelines, exceptions, and comms path

Hi team,

Following the product decision to soft-deprecate the legacy /v1/generate endpoint on 2027-02-01, I want to align on an "SDK shim" strategy that lets incremental customers (esp. ACME and BetaCorp) keep client integration working while we push them to the new /v2/chat-compatible API. Key asks:

- Confirm feasibility of a shim that rewrites common v1 payloads to v2 calls (minimal latency overhead).
- Define per-customer exemption criteria (e.g., >20M monthly tokens, custom model forks, on-prem constraints).
- Agree comms cadence & customer-facing language for the next two months.

Priority: ACME has asked for an extra 90-day window; they are a strategic enterprise (deal attached) so we should consider a scoped exception rather than a full rollback.

Can each of you share a short note on ops impacts, timeline to deliver a PoC shim, and rollback guardrails by EOD Friday? I drafted a one-page proposal (attached) to speed review.

Thanks — Irene

--
Irene Choi
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam@acme.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SDK shim sync: timelines, exceptions, and comms path

Irene — quick take from product/field:

Summary: A lightweight shim is viable for the most common patterns (text generation, single-turn chat). Limitations: function-calling, streaming semantics, and custom tokenization will be edge cases that require explicit SDK updates.

Timeline (rough):
- PoC shim (internal only): 3 weeks (target 2026-12-07) — rewriter + automated tests for canonical v1 payloads.
- Beta with selected partners (ACME, BetaCorp): 5 weeks after PoC (target 2026-01-11) — include telemetry to measure latency and error delta.
- Public SDK patch + docs: 8 weeks after PoC (target 2027-01-02).

Exception criteria suggestion:
- Short window exemption (90 days) only for customers on active migration plans and who accept a compatibility contract (we record that in HubSpot).
- Permanent exemptions for on-prem/private deployments only after infra review (Priyom).

Comms: recommend two-step messaging: 1) advance technical note + compatibility matrix; 2) follow-up mutual action plan for customers who request the temporary exemption.

I'll add more detail to the PoC checklist this afternoon.

— Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T15:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SDK shim sync: timelines, exceptions, and comms path

Thanks Ben — ops/engineering notes:

- Implementation approach: deploy shim as a middleware service in front of the inference routing layer. Prefer a feature flag so we can enable/disable per-tenant at the routing tier.
- Resource cost: expect a small CPU uplift on the control plane for payload translation; negligible GPU impact unless shim triggers streaming fallback.
- Canary strategy: 1) internal synthetic traffic → 2) 2 pilot customers (ACME, BetaCorp) at 1% traffic → 3) ramp to 10%/50%/100% by telemetry thresholds.
- Observability: need two new charts (shim error-rate by tenant, shim latency p50/p95) and a regression test harness that compares v1 vs v2 outputs for fidelity drift.

Rollback guardrails: immediate kill switch per-tenant + auto-failover to legacy handler for 5xx spikes. Also a weekly runbook for quality regressions (owner: Marissa/CS).

Attachments: I added a short runbook stub and the proposed feature-flag gating matrix to the shared drive (link below).

— Marissa

On Fri, Nov 16, 2026 at 11:03 AM Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Irene — quick take from product/field:
>
> Summary: A lightweight shim is viable for the most common patterns (text generation, single-turn chat). Limitations: function-calling, streaming semantics, and custom tokenization will be edge cases that require explicit SDK updates.

From: Sam Patel <sam@acme.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:42:00-05:00
Subject: Re: SDK shim sync: timelines, exceptions, and comms path

Hi Irene / Ben —

ACME appreciates the proactive plan. A few items from our side:

- We can accept a 90-day temporary exemption only if the shim preserves our streaming hooks and existing message ordering semantics. We run high-throughput streaming for real-time scoring.
- During the exemption window we need a simple telemetry contract (monthly delivery) that shows error/latency delta compared to our baseline.
- We will assign an engineering buddy to the pilot; they'll need PoC access by 2026-12-15 to validate streaming behavior.

If the PoC can't support streaming faithfully, we will request either an extended exemption or a temporary traffic split (some traffic on legacy endpoints).

— Sam
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam@acme.ai>, eng-team@betacorp.com
Date: 2026-11-25T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SDK shim sync: timelines, exceptions, and comms path — action items and MAP

Team — thanks for the quick inputs and Sam for the clarity from ACME. Action summary & owners: 

1) PoC shim (internal): owner Ben — deliver by 2026-12-07. Priority: streaming semantics must be included in the PoC harness.
2) Pilot access: owner Marissa — provision a per-tenant feature-flagged path and invite ACME + BetaCorp; target pilot start 2026-12-15.
3) Exemption contract template: owner Priyom + Legal — produce a short MOU for 90-day exceptions (include telemetry obligations).
4) Comms: owner Irene — publish two communications: (a) an advance technical brief to all affected customers by 2026-12-01; (b) targeted MAPs for customers opting into a temporary exemption.

Please update the HubSpot deal (ACME-ENT-2026-045) with pilot invite and attach the signed MOU once complete. I attached the mutual action plan spreadsheet and the initial SDK-shim proposal to this thread.

If any owner cannot meet the timeline, escalate to me by EOD Monday with a mitigation. We'll plan a 30-minute sync next Tuesday to review PoC progress.

Thanks — Irene

--
Irene Choi
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
